meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以按关键词、作者或主题在 arXiv、PubMed、IEEE 等平台搜索学术论文,并返回相关论文结果。
howto.when: 当你提到“搜索论文”“查找研究论文”“搜 arXiv/PubMed/IEEE/Scopus”等字眼时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下关于强化学习的 arXiv 论文
say.note: 会调用工具去 arXiv 搜索

say.text: 找几篇 PubMed 上关于糖尿病的文章
say.note: 会调用工具去 PubMed 搜索

say.text: 查一下张三在 IEEE 发表的论文
say.note: 会按作者在 IEEE 搜索

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search academic papers by keywords, authors, or topics across platforms like arXiv, PubMed, and IEEE, returning relevant results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention phrases like "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv/PubMed/IEEE/Scopus", etc.

say_en.text: Search arXiv for papers on reinforcement learning
say_en.note: It will call the tool to search arXiv
It will call the tool to search PubMed

say_en.text: Look up papers by Zhang San on IEEE
say_en.note: It will search IEEE by author
